description: Number of triples (A, S, R), where A is an acyclic digraph on n labeled nodes and a distinguished node r, S and R are subsets of V(A), r has no out-edge in A and belongs to R, such that adding a new node h with edges h -> S and R -> h gives a strongly connected digraph D reducible as a flow graph from every node, r has exactly one in-edge in D, and D - r is strongly connected.
